title: Playbook Plugin Migration To Crate And Taxonomy Consolidation
description: Migrate the 📖️playbook plugin's 7 constitutional crates (manifest/artifact, app facade, engine, dsl, op, pack, protocol, ui) into ONE crate at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📖️playbook/📦️packages/🦀️rust following the crate-consolidation-and-taxonomy-restructure recipe (TEMPLATE.md). Playbook's domain model (PlaybookSpec/PlaybookOperation/PlaybookDiff/etc, plus DocumentDsl/DocumentPack/OpBinary impls) is owned by the FRAMEWORK kernel crate semio-framework-os-kernel-playbook (untouched, out of scope) — this plugin only owns thin re-export wrappers + its own PlaybookConfig/PlaybookConfigOperation/PlaybookCommand/PlaybookPlayApp, closely mirroring the already-migrated 📋️forms plugin which shares the same kernel crate. The old ui crate has the known TEMPLATE §12.3 Ok(/Fault paren-corruption bug (does not compile) — fix as part of the port. Leave 🧩️extensions/🌀️procedural untouched (confirmed: depends directly on the framework kernel crate, not on old core crate names). Fix the one known cross-cutting dependent: dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep's Cargo.toml `playbook` dev-dependency alias currently points at the doomed old app-facade crate (semio-s-app-playbook) — repoint it to the framework kernel crate directly (same pattern used for forms' FormSpec). Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock — end with a registrar handoff block instead.
summary:
Migrated 📖️playbook's 7 old constitutional crates into one new crate `semio-s-plugin-playbook` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📖️playbook/📦️packages/🦀️rust, following TEMPLATE.md, closely mirroring the already-migrated 📋️forms plugin (same shared kernel domain, `playbook` = semio-framework-os-kernel-playbook, untouched framework crate).

Key findings: playbook's OLD bundle used a manual PluginBundle builder (not semio_plugin!); confirmed functionally equivalent to the macro form forms already uses, so migrated it to semio_plugin! with id "playbook-play" preserved verbatim (byte-identical bundle registration). The old ui crate had the known TEMPLATE §12.3 corruption pattern (Ok(/Fault paren mismatches, two match arms returning bare Emit{} instead of Ok(Emit{})) — did not compile at all; fixed as part of the port.

New taxonomy tree: 🗿️artifacts/📖️playbook/{🦀️component.rs (Types+artifact_kind), 🔺️diff, 🔧️op, 🗣️dsl, 🎒️pack, 📡️spr, ⚙️engine} all thin re-export wrappers over the kernel; 🎛️apps/📖️playbook/{🦀️component.rs, 🦀️config.rs, 🦀️terminology.rs, 🎮️commands/{🪜️step,🧱️block,🗂️selection,🗣️locale}, 🎭️modes/🏗️builder/🪟️windows/🏗️builder} — single mode/window app (Blockly-like builder), command decomposition via app_commands! (9 rows, keyed id+wire-key preserved verbatim from the old #[dsl(key)] attributes).

Test baseline: 14 passing (engine 3, op 2, dsl 3, pack 4, protocol 2) + 13 source-defined-but-broken (ui crate didn't compile) = 27-test correctness floor. New crate: 50/50 tests passing. Wire-format proof: byte-identical hex dump for all 9 PlaybookCommand variants + 3 PlaybookOperation constructors, captured before (old protocol crate temp test) and after (new crate temp test), diffed manually — every text/len/hex triple matches exactly. cargo check clean, cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2 clean, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean (only pre-existing warning in the semio-framework-plugin dependency, not ours). Ticket-local taxonomy-audit.ts (mirrors registry's validateTaxonomyTree) reports "taxonomy tree clean: 📖️playbook".

Confirmed 🧩️extensions/🌀️procedural was left completely untouched — it depends directly on the framework kernel crate (semio-framework-os-kernel-playbook), never on old core crate names, so no repoint was needed there.

Cross-cutting fix: 🧰️framework/.../dsl/🧪️fixture-sweep/⚡️implementations/🦀️rust/Cargo.toml's `playbook` dev-dependency alias was pointing at the now-deleted semio-s-app-playbook facade; repointed to the framework kernel crate directly (semio-framework-os-kernel-playbook) — a one-line path/package swap with zero 📦️lib.rs ripple (PlaybookSpec resolves identically through the kernel crate), matching the identical pattern already used for forms/note/dag/mathematical's own facade removals. Not yet compile-verified (root workspace is red until the registrar swaps playbook's member lines — expected transient state per TEMPLATE §8).

Deleted the 7 old crate directories: 🛂️manifest/🗿️artifact, 🎛️apps/📖️playbook/⚡️implementations, and 🎛️apps/📖️playbook/🔨️modules/{⚙️engine,🗣️dsl,🔧️op,🎒️pack,📡️protocol,🖱️ui}/⚡️implementations. Never touched root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, root 📜️script.ts, the registry generator, .vscode/launch.json, AGENTS.md, or any other plugin directory. Removed the temporary [workspace] verification overlay + nested target/Cargo.lock from the new crate's Cargo.toml before handoff.
